subject: Hosted evaluation: endpoint mapping, rate caps, and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation: endpoint mapping, rate caps, and next steps

Hi Samira — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can stand up a hosted quickstart for OliveTech next week.

What we covered (high level):
- Demo: chat flow + customer-centric prompts, streaming token-level responses
- Example endpoints we suggested: /v1/olivetech-chat (session state + KV cache), /v1/olivetech-batch-embed (bulk embeddings)
- Observability: per-endpoint latency & token cost dashboards, tracing hooks

What we need from you to provision a hosted pilot (please reply inline):
1) Traffic profile: approximate peak requests-per-second and expected average (per endpoint).
2) Latency SLO: target p95/p99 if you have one.
3) Any data residency constraints (US regions ok?).
4) Whether you want a single shared hosted endpoint for the pilot or separate endpoints for chat vs embeddings.

I've attached a simple endpoint matrix (OliveTech_endpoint_matrix.xlsx) — please fill the sample row(s) with expected QPS and concurrency so we can size capacity and recommend rate caps. Also attached a one-page quickstart steps doc for hosted evaluation.

Proposed next steps:
- You fill the matrix and reply with traffic numbers by EOD Thu (8/26)
- We stand up two trial endpoints (chat + embeddings) and share API keys and docs
- 30-minute sync after you run basic traffic tests to confirm perf and adjust rate caps

If you'd prefer Dedicated or Private VPC for the pilot, call that out in your reply and we'll provide a short pros/cons & provisional pricing for each path. For quick discovery, hosted tends to be fastest to spin up and iterate on.

Thanks — looking forward to your numbers.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojiin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@olivetech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: endpoint mapping, rate caps, and next steps

Hi Soojin — great session, thanks. Filling in the numbers below and a few notes inline.

Traffic summary (per endpoint):
- /v1/olivetech-chat: avg 8 req/s, typical peak 40 req/s, expected burst to ~90 req/s during major promotions (we can throttle on our side if needed)
- /v1/olivetech-batch-embed: avg 0.5 batch jobs / min, peaks up to 6 concurrent batches (each batch can contain up to 10k texts)

Latency targets: p95 < 350ms for chat responses (we can accept streaming), embeddings can be best-effort but prefer <2s per item.

Residency: US only for now.

Preference: For the pilot we prefer Hosted (fastest to iterate). If pilot shows steady high sustained throughput we will evaluate Dedicated. Private VPC is only if we move to production with specific compliance needs.

Procurement has been looped (cc). They will expect a short SOW + invoice terms.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can hosted trial endpoints be rate-capped per-endpoint so we can simulate degraded experience?
- Is there a token-based cost estimator we can run with our sample workload?
- For batch embeddings, is there a recommended chunking strategy to keep latency predictable?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Search & AI, OliveTech
samira.k@olivetech.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@olivetech.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: endpoint mapping, rate caps, and next steps

Hi Samira — quick replies to the questions you flagged, happy to jump on a call to walk through any item.

- Hosted trial rate caps: yes, we can create per-endpoint soft caps for the trial. Typical pilot config: soft cap at requested QPS with an enforced burst window; we can also provide a throttling profile that returns 429 with Retry-After so you can test degradation handling.

- Token-based cost estimator: attaching a short calculator internally (we'll send a Drive link + simple CSV you can run against sample prompts). For immediate estimates: we can share token/sample cost by model and endpoint after you run a few warmup tests.

- Batch chunking guidance: for embeddings, recommend chunk sizes of 256–1024 items for best throughput/latency tradeoff on hosted; we'll include a config example in the quickstart docs. For very large batches we recommend splitting into parallel jobs with a job queue.

Operational notes:
- We can provision the two hosted endpoints within 48 business hours after you return the filled matrix.
- If Procurement needs an SOW, Soojin can share v1 (I've dropped a PDF into the Drive link Soojin sent).

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: (internal) hosted_rateplaybook.md

- Initial rate targets: chat soft cap 45 rps, burst to 90 rps; embeddings parallel jobs up to 6 concurrent.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 350ms for chat; embeddings best-effort <2s per item.

2) Redwood to provision hosted trial endpoints within 48 business hours of receiving the matrix and share API keys + quickstart.
3) Conduct a 30-min perf run and sync (propose Tue 8/31 or Wed 9/1) — I'll send an invite once test window is confirmed.
